title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Reduction of the Platform Fee Part of the Early Termination Fee
content:
The platform fee part of the monthly charge of the early termination fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is reduced for a Paystride Payroll Card Program:

- where the employer holds a Payroll Card Program in live status with a launch date on or before the notice date and held in the Paystride Paycard Program Premier or Paystride Paycard Program Elite package, it is reduced by the tier's Payroll Card bundle discount percentage plus 5 percent;
- where it holds such a live Payroll Card Program in any other package, it is reduced by the tier's Payroll Card bundle discount percentage;
- otherwise it is not reduced.

The facts are read from the employer's Paystride Payroll Card Program record: its status, launch date and package.

| Program tier | Bundle discount percentage | Reduction, Premier or Elite package | Reduction, other package |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | 10 | 15 | 10 |
| Growth | 10 | 15 | 10 |
| Professional | 15 | 20 | 15 |
| Enterprise | 15 | 20 | 15 |
| Enterprise Plus | 20 | 25 | 20 |
| Strategic | 20 | 25 | 20 |

A Payroll Card Program not in live status, or launched after the notice date, gives no reduction.

**Scope beside the platform-fee discount.** The Payroll Card bundle discount applies only to the platform fee, never to per-worker, sponsored, implementation, termination or return fee lines, and an SLA credit for the same month is computed on the discounted fee, except that the per-worker fee, the early termination fee and the base of the service level credit for the latest census month are set by their own provisions, the early termination fee being set by the early termination fee provisions.
